summary: Thin wrapper that converts the address of the global function pointer PhysicsStateAccessor to an integer, passes it to BooleanToIntConversion, and returns the result verbatim. No arguments, no local state, no branches.

operations.description: Take the address of the global PhysicsStateAccessor and cast it to int.
Call BooleanToIntConversion with the integer address of PhysicsStateAccessor.

unresolved: What BooleanToIntConversion does with the address is outside this packet; it likely treats the pointer as a state token or validity signal rather than a boolean value.
Whether this wrapper registers or merely reports the accessor is unclear (no callers are listed, and the global is only read).
